# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_targetable_<key>  THIS may send its next fleet there: unclaimed, and under
#                           races only of a stage reached (the draw's candidates), under
#                           simple and full of stage 1 or 2, or with Deep Space
#                           Exploration or a colony held (design § 3)
#   sr_cf_departs_<key>     a fleet can leave for it this month (its body's window, a
#                           paid launch the approach accepts, or a torch; Mercury always)
#   sr_cf_eligible_<key>    the automatic pick may take it: targetable, departs, its cost
#                           covered, its transit within 180 months (design § 7);
#                           the goal alone first, the cheap test before the window's
#   sr_cf_beaten_<key>      a fleet already on its way lands no later than ours would
sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = {
	NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
	OR = {
		AND = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } sr_current_colonization_stage >= 1 }
		sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
	}
}
sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = { sr_launch_target_cost_mars < sr_launch_never }
sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = {
	sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
	sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris
	sr_transit_months_mars <= sr_cf_horizon_months
}
sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = {
	has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris
	sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris >= global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris
}

# The country's target (var:sr_cf_target, a world's index) is still targetable.
sr_cf_target_valid = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 6 sr_cf_targetable_ceres = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 sr_cf_targetable_vesta = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 sr_cf_targetable_psyche = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 9 sr_cf_targetable_pallas = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 10 sr_cf_targetable_hygiea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 11 sr_cf_targetable_io = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 12 sr_cf_targetable_europa = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 13 sr_cf_targetable_ganymede = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 14 sr_cf_targetable_callisto = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 15 sr_cf_targetable_himalia = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 16 sr_cf_targetable_amalthea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 17 sr_cf_targetable_venus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 18 sr_cf_targetable_mercury = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 19 sr_cf_targetable_titan = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 20 sr_cf_targetable_enceladus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 21 sr_cf_targetable_rhea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 22 sr_cf_targetable_mimas = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 23 sr_cf_targetable_iapetus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 24 sr_cf_targetable_titania = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 25 sr_cf_targetable_oberon = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 26 sr_cf_targetable_miranda = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 27 sr_cf_targetable_ariel = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 28 sr_cf_targetable_triton = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 29 sr_cf_targetable_proteus = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 30 sr_cf_targetable_pluto = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 31 sr_cf_targetable_eris = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 32 sr_cf_targetable_makemake = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 33 sr_cf_targetable_haumea = yes }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 34 sr_cf_targetable_sedna = yes }
	}
}

# The target can be launched for now: targetable, departs, its cost covered.
sr_cf_target_ready = {
	has_variable = sr_cf_target
	OR = {
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes sr_cf_departs_olympus_mons = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_olympus_mons }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_hellas_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_hellas_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 sr_cf_targetable_utopia_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_utopia_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_utopia_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 sr_cf_targetable_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_arcadia_planitia }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 6 sr_cf_targetable_ceres = yes sr_cf_departs_ceres = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_ceres }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 sr_cf_targetable_vesta = yes sr_cf_departs_vesta = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_vesta }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 sr_cf_targetable_psyche = yes sr_cf_departs_psyche = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_psyche }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 9 sr_cf_targetable_pallas = yes sr_cf_departs_pallas = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_pallas }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 10 sr_cf_targetable_hygiea = yes sr_cf_departs_hygiea = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_hygiea }
		AND = { var:sr_cf_target = 11 sr_cf_targetable_io = yes sr_cf_departs_io = yes sr_progress_solar_colonization_value >= sr_cf_cost_io }
